papers.title: A COMPASS to the Galaxy: Joint nucleosynthetic yield set comparison and parameter inference in Galactic chemical evolution
papers.summary: Score-based diffusion simulation-based inference jointly compares nucleosynthetic yield sets and infers Galactic chemical evolution parameters, favoring hybrid NuGrid+IllustrisTNG yields for Milky Way data.

papers.title: Model-Driven Stellar Spectroscopy with the Total Differential Spectral Model (TDSM): Framework and Its Application to 11 Million LAMOST Low-Resolution Spectra
papers.summary: A physically motivated neural network emulates Kurucz flux and derivatives, deriving eight stellar labels for 11 million LAMOST low-resolution spectra.

papers.title: Neural Surrogates for Tabulated Nuclear Equations of State in Core-Collapse Supernova Simulations
papers.comment: 15 pages, 14 figures, accepted for publication in PASJ
papers.summary: Neural surrogate replaces tabulated nuclear equation of state in core-collapse supernova simulations, reproducing shock-tube and collapse dynamics while cutting EOS memory about 1500-fold.

papers.title: Improving Early Detection of Scientifically Interesting Radio Sources Using Enhanced Isolation Forest
papers.summary: Enhanced Isolation Forest variants rank scientifically interesting MeerKAT radio sources using BYOL-PCA features, improving early-stage prioritization over standard anomaly detection.

papers.title: From Non-parametric Statistics to Images: Generating Galaxy Morphologies
papers.comment: 19 pages, 8 figures,accepted for publication in Universe
papers.summary: Flow-VAE combines a variational autoencoder and conditional normalizing flow to generate galaxy images matching prescribed CAS, Gini, and M20 statistics.

papers.title: Testing General Relativity by Reconstructing Dark Energy and the Growth Index with Physics-Informed Neural Networks
papers.summary: Physics-informed neural networks reconstruct dark energy and growth index from DESI DR2 BAO, cosmic chronometers, supernovae, and redshift-space distortions, finding suppressed structure growth.

papers.title: Beam-pattern Prediction for Radio Antenna Arrays using Mutual Coupling and Machine Learning
papers.summary: A deep neural network predicts phased-array beam patterns from antenna design, positions, frequency, and measured scattering parameters, accounting for mutual coupling.

excluded.title: Euclid Data Release 1 (DR1). Double-source-plane lens candidates
